general.statement: Code generated should not treat an intermediate UI state as a finalized human label.
Code generated should not discard the model proposal or the human-saved result needed to explain a later model decision.
Code generated should not overwrite the complete initial grouping when a human begins dragging photos.

feature.statement: Code generated should not write grouping feedback as final until the user submits Save grouping and crop.
Code generated should not train from only moved photos when unchanged final assignments are available; every reviewed photo needs an initial and final assignment.

negative_tests.name: grouping feedback schema persists versioned state
